Joly UI - 50+ Free shadcn/ui Components for React & Next.js

name: Joly UI
summary: 50+ free copy-paste React components extending shadcn/ui, with animated text effects and motion.
description: Open-source collection of 50+ additional components for shadcn/ui projects, grouped as buttons, creative, feedback, inputs, navigation, surfaces and text animations. Built on Radix UI primitives with framer-motion animations, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS v4, and works with Next.js 14+ and React 19. Install with the shadcn CLI from the Joly UI registry or copy the source by hand.
